summary: This bill amends 31 U.S.C. 1304 to bar Judgment Fund payments for settlements or awards benefiting the President, Vice President, their relatives, cabinet members, senior EOP staff, or political appointees, or claims tied to January 6, 2016 election interference, or certain dismissed suits, while also blocking federal funding for the compensation fund created by the May 2026 Trump v. IRS settlement and requiring Treasury reporting and a 120-day delay for large payouts.
